rows.transcript_gb_en_m:
Here is something fun to help you let go of stress:   

Choose a song that reflects what you need in this moment. Do you need a gentle song to soothe your tired soul or an upbeat song to help you shake some stress out?   

Make a space and move your body to the music. Remember to breathe while you move. Let your breath and the movement go together. 

Even a few minutes of movement can be enough to release stress and lift your mood!
rows.transcript_my_ms_m:
Berikut adalah sesuatu yang menyeronokkan untuk membantu anda melepaskan tekanan:

Pilih sebuah lagu yang sesuai dengan apa yang anda perlukan saat ini. Adakah anda perlukan lagu yang lembut dan perlahan untuk menenangkan jiwa yang letih, atau lagu yang rancak untuk membantu anda rasa bertenaga dan keluarkan rasa tertekan anda?

Cari ruang dan gerakkan tubuh anda mengikut irama. Ingat untuk terus bernafas semasa anda bergerak. Biarkan nafas dan pergerakan anda selari.

Pergerakan selama beberapa minit pun sudah cukup untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menceriakan mood anda!

text_1_facilitator.eng: This skill is about creating routines with your child. Routines are things we do every day. 🔄

text_2.eng:
Creating daily routines with your child will help them feel more secure and safe. 🔑 

You can help create regular times for resting ⏰, meals 🍚, chores 🌱, school 📖, and sleep 🌙.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 3️⃣ Here are three tips on how to create routines with your child.

section_1_text.eng:
🎈 Talk to your child about how they’d like their routines to look like.
✨ Did you know? When children help set routines, they’re more likely to stick to them—give it a try! 💚

section_2_text.eng:
⏰ Help your child follow their routines every day.
🌱 Activities become easier to manage when children learn and get used to a routine.
🔄 Consistent routines help your child learn about daily activities and how to manage their time.

section_3_text.eng:
🎈 Praise your child for setting a routine with you.
⭐ Praise your child when they follow the routine.

quiz_1_question.eng: Do you have time to try setting routines with your child today? ⏰

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng: That's great! Create ONE regular daily routine, like having a meal together or going for a walk. It will help your child feel secure and loved.

quiz_1_feedback_2.eng: That's great! Create ONE regular daily routine, like having a meal together or going for a walk. It will help your child feel secure and loved.

quiz_1_feedback_3.eng:
That's OK! Beginning something new takes time. You can start with something simple, like creating a time when you and your child can do something together. ⚽ 

For example, having dinner or going for a walk. Ask your child for ideas on which routines could be useful for them. They might surprise you! ⏰🍚🚲
